subject: Follow-up: Enablers 03 753 (E04, E06-E10) and Story Set 02 438 (N30-N32) on D:, new MANIFEST SHAs
body:
Follow-up: more Enablers and Story Set drafts have landed on D:. Only new files were added and no image was overwritten.

GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03: 753 images (829 files). New: E04-mouth-states (15), E06-mouth-macros (15), E07-hands, E08-cheek-lettering (15), E09-neck-blaster-macro (15) and E10-chest-ship (15 for now, more to come).
E07-hands has 25 images. Shots 003, 004, 009, 013 and 015 each appear in three forms: the original unsuffixed draft from the first push, a -v001 copy of it, and a -v002 redo. All are kept, and the v002 files are the current ones.
MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: ee5470dc827fbf55819e0f5d8ffc4cf30ea10d437c6ebb6ac0914635cf97690a (supersedes 3183a3d8...082b)

GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02: 438 images (486 files). New: N30-cab-lift, N31-cab-interior and N32-street-landing (15 each). N27-grill-in is still at 3.
MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: 1c7015296e3e13d3b65f2e39f767a90b12b58c04f5831b1f87efa4458dfae4fa (supersedes 1c492c27...4679)

SHORTLIST.md was rebuilt for both archives. Falcon is unchanged at 1,189.
Remaining gaps: E02-E03, E48, N27 (12 more to reach 15), N28 and N29.
Everything is preliminary, with no song timestamps, and nothing is accepted until Nova intake or Ziggy accepts it.
